title: Sequencer.md omits the fallbacks of solver agent selection
summary: Sequencer.md stated that the solver on the imager agent's host is used, but sequencer_solver_agent() also falls back to a solver on another host and finally to Astrometry Agent on the imager's host. Document both.
evidence: Independent review Q2; indigo_drivers/agent_scripting/library/Sequencer.md start() paragraph; quality-review.md.

resolution.evidence: Sequencer.md start() paragraph documents same-host preference, other-host and default fallbacks; reinspected in quality-review.md.
